entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to return a VeloBand. Just give me the return authorization.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered on December 24th, about 25 days ago. For my records, what specifically is the issue with the band?

Look, I don't have time for a survey. It's been a mess here. My husband's deployment got moved up, and then there was a family emergency. My father had to have unexpected surgery and was in the hospital for a week. I just want to know if I can return it or not.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I certainly hope everything is okay now. And yes, absolutely, that won't be a problem. Let me just double-check the policy...

Okay, yes, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 25, you are well within the window. There's no need for an exception. I can process this for you right now.
Great. Finally, a simple answer. So you're sending me a shipping label?

That's correct. I've just processed the return in our system. You should receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 10 minutes. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're most welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
